PROCEDURES_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: Procedures are merchant-authored instructions Gotchu follows when a customer message matches a trigger phrase you write. Write one, test it against recent conversations with Replay, then activate it.
PROCEDURES_MGMT.NO_RESULTS: No procedures found matching your search

UNCONFIGURED.DESCRIPTION: Procedures are not configured on this Chatwoot. Set the following on the gateway and restart it to turn this on:

ERRORS.UNCONFIGURED: Procedures are not configured on this Chatwoot, so nothing was sent.
ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: Could not confirm the request reached Gotchu. Check the gateway before trying again.
ERRORS.INVALID: Gotchu rejected this procedure. Check the slug format, the length limits, and that the title, body and trigger phrases don't name a specific customer or order.
ERRORS.DUPLICATE_SLUG: A procedure with this slug already exists for this store.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This procedure no longer exists. Reload the list.
ERRORS.STALE_VERSION: The procedure changed since you opened it. Reload the page and try again.
ERRORS.NOT_ACTIVE_FOR_AUTO: Only an active procedure can be raised to auto. Activate it first.
ERRORS.VERSION_REQUIRED: A procedure version is required to change a channel. Reload the page and try again.

SLUG.LABEL: Slug
SLUG.HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, 3-40 characters.
SLUG.IMMUTABLE: The slug is set on creation and cannot be changed.
SLUG.PATTERN_ERROR: Must match ^[a-z0-9_]{3,40}$ -- lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, 3-40 characters.

TITLE.LABEL: Title
TITLE.LENGTH_ERROR: Title must be at most 100 characters.

BODY.LABEL: Body
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: What the desk should do for this case...
BODY.LENGTH_ERROR: Body must be at most 4000 characters.

PHRASES.LABEL: Trigger phrases
PHRASES.PLACEHOLDER: Type a phrase and press Enter
PHRASES.HINT: How a customer might ask for this, in their own words. Up to {max} phrases.
PHRASES.MIN_ERROR: At least one trigger phrase is required.
PHRASES.MAX_ERROR: At most 12 trigger phrases are allowed.

STORE.LABEL: Store
STORE.GLOBAL_DESCRIPTION: This procedure applies to conversations from any store.
STORE.SCOPED_DESCRIPTION: This procedure only applies to {store} conversations.

CREATE.DESCRIPTION: A new procedure starts in Testing. It only reaches drafts once you activate it.

REPLAY.TITLE: Replay results
REPLAY.MATCH_COUNT: {count} conversation would have matched this procedure. | {count} conversations would have matched this procedure.
REPLAY.SCOPE_CAPPED: Scanned the last {considered} conversations -- more exist in the window than this scan covers.
REPLAY.TIMED_OUT: The scan did not finish in time. These numbers are partial.

CHANNEL_TIERS.TITLE: Channels
CHANNEL_TIERS.DESCRIPTION: Turn this procedure on per channel. Draft lets Gotchu propose a reply for a supporter to send; Auto lets it send without review.
CHANNEL_TIERS.AUTO_DISABLED_HINT: Activate this procedure before a channel on it can be raised to auto.
CHANNEL_TIERS.AUTO_LIMITED_HINT: Auto can be turned on here, but nothing sends automatically on this channel yet -- every draft is refused as "order not verified", because a visitor's identity on this channel can be spoofed.
